1.web: It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High;
1.asv: It is a good thing to give thanks unto Jehovah, And to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High;

2.web: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
2.asv: To show forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, And thy faithfulness every night,

3.web: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
3.asv: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.

4.web: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
4.asv: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

5.web: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
5.asv: How great are thy works, O Jehovah! Thy thoughts are very deep.

6.web: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
6.asv: A brutish man knoweth not; Neither doth a fool understand this:

7.web: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
7.asv: When the wicked spring as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they shall be destroyed for ever.

8.web: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.
8.asv: But thou, O Jehovah, art on high for evermore.

9.web: For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
9.asv: For, lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, For, lo, thine enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

10.web: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
10.asv: But my horn hast thou exalted like the horn of the wild-ox: I am anointed with fresh oil.

11.web: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
11.asv: Mine eye also hath seen my desireon mine enemies, Mine ears have heard my desire of the evil-doers that rise up against me.

12.web: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
12.asv: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

13.web: They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
13.asv: They are planted in the house of Jehovah; They shall flourish in the courts of our God.

14.web: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
14.asv: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and green:

15.web: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
15.asv: To show that Jehovah is upright; He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
